prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System advises, never autonomously dispatches. Aliases: Duty Detection Officer=Orion; Air Attack Supervisor=Redtail; Caldera Incident Command Portal=Emberhall; Horizon Ridge Drone Dock=Kestrel; Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine=Lantern; MesoWest Weather Fusion Node=Brindle; Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console=Marigold; VHF Radio Gateway Repeater=Badger. Smoke Classifier Module sends Orion likelihood/growth/obscuration/confidence/Ridge Shadow Mask/warnings; camera unavailability/poor-quality makes detections advisory; degradation cannot justify commitment. North Lookout Camera Mast supplies Thermal Spot Snippet/bearings; South Lookout Camera Mast supplies bearings/Camera Cleaning Log; both report heartbeat/temperature/storage/pointing-status. Brindle publishes Wind Shift Bulletin/exposure/recomputations; caches weather. Lantern fuses perimeter/growth/weather/fuels/reconnaissance; requires confidence/timing validity. Imagery requires orthorectification/grid-registration. Reject unversioned/unsigned configuration; retain approved configuration during outage. Redtail approves reconnaissance/drops/intent/conflicts. Delayed Confirmed Ignition State blocks dispatch; Confirmed Ignition State changes require assignment-review; Airspace Restricted State requires route/altitude acceptance and Helitack Crew Leader boundary-confirmation. Drone Tasking Service packages/tracks missions, avoids aviation-lanes; validates County Emergency Liaison's Drone Corridor Permit before degraded-communications automated-task release, without independent release authority. Kestrel reports readiness/health/recovery; maintenance controller produces Battery Swap Ticket; Drone Pilot Operator confirms safety/readiness. Marigold validates Runway Release Note/Suppression Drop Receipt; blocks unapproved/unready release. East Retardant Loading Pump supplies Retardant Batch Slip; excessive pressure-variance triggers metered recirculation. Tanker Base Manager verifies assignment/quantity, coordinates West Retardant Loading Pump; shift-change inspection precedes availability. Pumps report state/flow/outages, not approval. Emberhall audits provenance/uncertainty/Crew Staging Pin/assignments/acknowledgments. Disconnected mode timestamps caches, queues authorized updates, prohibits irreversible releases. Crewline Mobile Tablet rejects expired packages; encrypts queues, preserves author/device-time/server-acceptance-time. Access: named accounts, role-based least-privilege, reachable-service MFA; otherwise expiring pre-issued signed credentials, restoration supervisor-review. Production administration requires separate

New part:
S197: Operational records that support command decisions and safety reviews shall be retained for the incident record period defined by agency policy, while high-volume raw sensor data may follow a shorter approved retention schedule.
S198: The system shall protect retained data with encryption at rest, controlled export procedures, and deletion workflows that require documented authorization.
S199: For incidents lasting multiple operational periods, spare power, replacement network equipment, field cleaning supplies, and documented recovery procedures shall be staged so that no single equipment fault stops detection or suppression-support operations.
S200: Training for the Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System shall be completed before each fire season and refreshed whenever operating procedures or field configurations change.
S201: The training program shall be role based so that each participant practices the decisions, system functions, communications, and safety constraints that apply to the assigned position.
S202: The Duty Detection Officer shall be trained to operate the Caldera Incident Command Portal, review detections, validate confidence indicators, and escalate suspected ignitions according to the approved incident workflow.
S203: Camera familiarization shall cover the North Lookout Camera Mast and the South Lookout Camera Mast, including normal image behavior, degraded visibility conditions, routine inspection cues, and reporting of equipment faults.
S204: The Duty Detection Officer shall also learn how the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine and the Smoke Classifier Module present uncertainty so that human confirmation remains part of every operational decision.
S205: The Drone Pilot Operator shall be trained on Horizon Ridge Drone Dock procedures, Drone Tasking Service mission controls, safe launch checks, recovery actions, and loss-of-link coordination.
S206: The Air Attack Supervisor shall be trained to interpret system status during aerial operations and to coordinate with the Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console without bypassing airspace safety requirements.
S207: The Tanker Base Manager shall receive practical instruction on status entry, loading coordination, and abnormal-condition reporting for the East Retardant Loading Pump and the West Retardant Loading Pump.
S208: The Helitack Crew Leader shall be trained on use of the Crewline Mobile Tablet, field acknowledgments, location updates, and communication discipline during changing fire behavior.
S209: During field mobilization drills, the Helitack Crew Leader shall use the staging pin to confirm that the assigned crew is positioned at the exercise location.
S210: The County Emergency Liaison shall be trained to interpret public-safety information from the Caldera Incident Command Portal and to coordinate notifications with county procedures.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
